message.content:
This editorial illustration shows the front cover of Tempo magazine. At the top, white text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS PEMILIHAN UMUM 2019" above a large white "TEMPO" logo and the smaller subtitle "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A light-blue helicopter flies in a pale green sky near stylized green tree canopies. Below, a white neoclassical building features a central pediment with a gold emblem. A red-and-white flag flies on the right.

Prominent mirror-reversed orange and yellow text, "SAATNYA MEMILIH", arcs across the center. Four caricatured men with tan skin and black hair are positioned behind a counter. From left to right: the first man wears a black songkok and raises two fingers; the second wears rectangular glasses; the third has closed eyes; and the fourth wears glasses and a black songkok.

In the foreground, numerous white ceramic bowls filled with various foods are stacked on a blue surface. The bowls contain red eggs, brown round items, sliced red discs, and dark-colored stews. At the bottom left, a white barcode with the number "00008" and a series of digits sits next to blurred red and white text. A green spoon rests in a bowl of orange liquid at the bottom center.
